_meta.dataset: NYC 2027 Candidate Hotels — Line-by-Line Official First-Party Verification, NYC Tax & Fee Math, and Feb 15–Mar 23, 2027 Window Analysis
_meta.hard_room_requirements: Private en-suite bathroom + 1 Queen bed or larger (Queen, King, XL King, or 2 Queens)

nyc_tax_formula.note: Per NYC Department of Finance, rooms >= $40/day incur 5.875% NYC Hotel Room Occupancy Tax + $2.00/day NYC flat tax + 8.875% NYS/NYC/MCTD sales tax (14.75% combined) + $1.50/day NYS unit fee = $3.50/night flat statutory fees ($24.50 over 7 nights), NOT a universal '$4/night city tax'. Mandatory hotel facility/resort fees are subject to tax where applicable.

_meta.official_direct_quote_status: UNVERIFIED — hotel direct booking engines (SynXis, Marriott, Hyatt, Pestana, Choice) require interactive client-side session tokens for Feb 15–22, 2027 checkout totals.
